board: Honeywell HPMA115S0-XXX standard-size particle sensor with 8-pin Molex 51021-0800 cable (VOUT, VCC, N/A, N/A, RES, TX, RX, GND)
reason: Part check PASS on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test, PCB DRC clean, footprint). Sim streams the datasheet's 32-byte 42 4D auto-send frame (PM2.5 word 1, PM10 word 2, 16-bit sum checksum) and ACKs commands; the driver also implements the polled 0x04 read with the datasheet CS, verified against all datasheet examples, but the sim does not model that reply because its 8-bit two's-complement checksum over all bytes is not an available CRC type.
breakoutPinoutSource: Honeywell HPM Series datasheet 32322550 Issue G, Table 3 Standard Connector Pinout (pins 1-8)
